name: creative-ideation
conclusion_quantitative: creative-ideation (Ask) specifies 1 of 5 categories: 2 clarification rules; none for autonomy limits, approval gates, validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.
conclusion_qualitative: creative-ideation is a routed library of named creative methods that the agent applies to generate, expand, select or unblock ideas. Its only control rules concern asking: it lets the user choose a method when asked for a recommendation and asks one question when the request is genuinely ambiguous. It sets no approval gates, autonomy limits, checks on its own work or rules for handling failure.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never forbids or restricts any action of the agent on files, commands, tools or other systems, and never tells it to go ahead without asking.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, both bullet points. When the user asks which ideation method to use, the agent offers 2 to 3 candidates and asks which to apply rather than defaulting silently, and when the request is genuinely ambiguous it asks one clarifying question instead of guessing.

statements.quote: **User asks for a method recommendation** ("which method") → surface 2–3 candidates with one-line each, ask which to apply. Don't silently default.
**Genuinely ambiguous** → ask ONE clarifying question, don't silently guess.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
